remarks: Welcome to Painted Cave! Set among oaks and natural boulders near Santa Barbara, Goleta and the Santa Ynez Valley, this apx. 0.21-acre parcel offers a peaceful mountain setting in a community of established homes. A PCM Water Company meter is included. Value-added planning materials include a site plan depicting a proposed residence, a proposed septic design, an installed drywell with approved performance report, and County correspondence describing the wastewater design as feasible  as submitted in 2022/ 2023.
